# E0357: a mapping calls a function a lens may not call

A mapping calls a function the lens language does not have. A computed
mapping may use CUE's arithmetic, comparisons and the strings functions the
help lists; anything else would make a lens whose totality thema cannot
check.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
	count?: int
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		name: strings.Reverse(v0_0.name)
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	v1_0: _
	v0_0: {
		name: v1_0.name
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0357]: strings.Reverse is not a function a lens may call
 --> history/1.0.thema:8:9
  |
8 |         name: strings.Reverse(v0_0.name)
  |               ^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: the strings functions a lens may call are strings.Contains, strings.HasPrefix, strings.HasSuffix, strings.Replace, strings.ToLower, strings.ToUpper, strings.Trim, strings.TrimLeft, strings.TrimPrefix, strings.TrimRight, strings.TrimSpace, strings.TrimSuffix

error[E0347]: 0.0 declares count and 1.0 does not, and nothing maps it: write <field>: v0_0.count to move it, or count: _drop
 --> history/1.0.thema:5:1
  |
5 | ForwardLens: {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
```
